self-hiddenstreak-20261030-013109-004.readme:
# Conscious – Going-Quiet Flag for tutors
Flags students who are drifting (no-show/cancel patterns) from a session CSV.
Usage: python quiet.py s.csv   (cols: student,date,status)
Built with Marcus, a San Jose tutoring owner, who tested it on real data: it caught S014 (no-show + cancel). Rule: flag if latest session missed or 2 of last 3 missed.
Civic angle: keeps students from silently dropping out of tutoring.
